title: One member, five sources, one profile
objective: Learners follow one member’s data from five source systems into a customer data platform and through its stages (ingest, harmonise, unify, calculate, activate), and see how which sources are connected, how fast the triggering feed arrives and what the member consented to decide whether the platform acts in time, late, or not at all.

recommended.why: A narrated story with a member, a bad morning and a platform that may or may not notice makes the five stages and their failure modes memorable for architects and executives alike.

alternative.why: A narrated story versus a 3D walkthrough versus the architecture diagram: which makes the stages and the timing stick?

assumptions: Systems, timings and names are illustrative; no real health plan, product configuration or SLA is implied

Five sources can feed the platform: member portal, CRM, claims system, marketing platform and contact centre; the control connects them in that order, so the claims feed is the third source and the contact centre the fifth
Portal, CRM and contact-centre records stream within seconds; the marketing platform syncs hourly; the claims feed is either streaming or a nightly batch that lands at 02:00
Identity resolution matches on member number, email and phone, and every record matches Maria; the Who is Maria? lesson covers what happens when match rules are loose or strict
The at-risk insight is "a denied claim and two or more status checks within an hour"; it needs the claims feed to have arrived
The service follow-up is a service communication and does not need marketing consent; the appeal-guide email is marketing and does

Salesforce names map the generic roles: Data 360 for the platform stages, Health Cloud for the CRM, Agentforce for the service agent; the claims system stays generic because it is usually not Salesforce
units: real time: hours and minutes after the claim is denied at 09:00 (playback runs separately, about 35 s)
sources: systems connected to the platform, 2 to 5
calls: times Maria has to phone the contact centre
checkDescription: The unified profile holds exactly one record set per connected source; the at-risk insight fires only when the claims feed is connected; the agent sees the denial on the first call only when that feed streams; the marketing journey runs only for an opted-in member with the marketing platform connected; events run in time order and the names switch changes nothing else.

learnerPrompts.predict: Switch the claims feed to a nightly batch before you play. The agent takes Maria’s 09:50 call: what will they see on her profile, and when will the platform flag her?
learnerPrompts.explain: Set the sources to Portal + CRM. The profile still fills up and identity resolution still works, yet nothing is activated. Why is that not an identity problem, and which single connection would have changed Maria’s week?
